hints.title: Prefix Alignment Condition
hints.text: At step i (1-indexed), the binary string is prefix aligned if the first i bits are all 1 and the rest are 0.

hints.title: Maximum Index Seen So Far
hints.text: Track the maximum index seen up to step i. Since exactly i bits have been turned on, the max index must equal i.

hints.title: Count Valid Steps
hints.text: Whenever max_val == i, all turned on bits must occupy positions 1 through i, so increment the counter.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking the whole prefix array at each step takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking the running maximum requires only O(1) auxiliary space and linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate realizes that if max flipped index is i after i steps, the prefix 1..i is contiguous.
